generator.reproducibility: The adapter recreates the frozen semantic scenario. Frozen Core-generated UUIDs and timestamps mean a rerun is not claimed to reproduce byte-identical SQL; committed artifact hashes remain authoritative.

generation_evidence.purpose: One-time clean-checkpoint export evidence only; the SQL dump and semantic artifacts are the committed fixture.

runtime_verification.private_reference_authentication: approved local checkout or read-only token; when configured, CI token use is limited to trusted post-merge main pushes
runtime_verification.exact_frozen_core: seeds and later inspects the preserved canonical schema-11 snapshot
runtime_verification.tauri_app_state_shell_api: keeps Shell unpublished before test bootstrap, writes A through the production Shell API boundary, and reopens A/B after the standalone recovery client exits
runtime_verification.source_compatible_recovery_client: a separately prebuilt Shell API client reopens the selected committed database generation, reads write A, persists write B, and is followed by a Tauri AppState/Shell A/B readback; its executable SHA-256 is bound into ephemeral runtime evidence
runtime_verification.source_compatible_scope: host-neutral source/database and command-equivalent Shell-boundary compatibility only; no AppHandle, platform plugin, installer, signature, platform vault, or platform update mechanism is exercised
runtime_verification.ci_secret_absent_result: NOT_RUN; no exact-runtime pass is claimed

credential_evidence.limitation: Signed per-platform install/update/forward-versioned compatible recovery, including post-Tauri A/B data and credential-vault continuity, is NOT_RUN and remains a release gate.
